description:
• From the infamous and best Shiteventersunite (SEU) equestrian Facebook group. 
• The funniest and most loved equestrian calendar in the world.
• The calendar features 13 months of hilarious images of epic fails that have been created by the members over the course of 2023. It also has the major eventing show dates added to the calendar. Sold in more than 50 countries, the calendar sells itself.
